2608.28378.title: PersonaForge: Realistic Multi-Turn User Simulation for Agentic Systems
2608.28378.paper_summary: Large language models are increasingly used as agentic workflow executors, yet existing training data and benchmarks largely assume informationally complete, single-turn queries. Our analysis of 16K real-world sessions shows that 75.9% of interactions are multi-turn, revealing a substantial gap between how users interact with agents and how such systems are trained and evaluated. We introduce \textbf{PersonaForge}, a user simulation framework for synthesizing realistic multi-turn user--agent interactions. PersonaForge combines a four-dimensional persona space, SOUL-driven behavioral control calibrated to real-user statistics, and Reverse Deep Construction grounded in authentic seed queries. Using PersonaForge, we construct a 6.3K-record training dataset and \textbf{PersonaForge-Bench}, a manually annotated 138-task benchmark spanning over 20 professional domains with four-dimensional scoring. Experiments on Qwen3.5-27B show that PersonaForge training improves the composite score by +4.1%, with gains across all four dimensions and the largest improvements in Task Completion (+6.0%) and Response Quality (+6.8%). Further analyses show that PersonaForge-trained agents use fewer turns and tool calls, suggesting improved interaction efficiency, while ablations confirm the contribution of SOUL components and adaptive simulation. Together, PersonaForge and PersonaForge-Bench establish a foundation for training and evaluating agents under realistic multi-turn user interaction.
2608.28378.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型越來越多地被用作有代理性的工作流程執行者，然而現有的訓練數據和基準大多假設資訊完整的單輪查詢。我們對16K個真實世界會話的分析顯示，75.9%的互動是多輪的，揭示了用戶與代理互動的方式與這些系統的訓練和評估之間存在著實質性的差距。我們介紹了\textbf{PersonaForge}，一個用戶模擬框架，用於合成真實的多輪用戶-代理互動。PersonaForge結合了四維角色空間、基於真實用戶統計的SOUL驅動行為控制，以及基於真實種子查詢的反向深度構建。使用PersonaForge，我們構建了一個包含6.3K記錄的訓練數據集和\textbf{PersonaForge-Bench}，這是一個手動標註的138任務基準，涵蓋20多個專業領域並具有四維評分。對Qwen3.5-27B的實驗顯示，PersonaForge訓練使綜合得分提高了+4.1%，在所有四個維度上均有增長，且在任務完成度(+6.0%)和回應質量(+6.8%)上有最大的改善。進一步的分析顯示，經過PersonaForge訓練的代理使用了更少的輪次和工具調用，這表明互動效率有所提高，而消融實驗確認了SOUL組件和自適應模擬的貢獻。總之，PersonaForge和PersonaForge-Bench為在現實多輪用戶互動下訓練和評估代理奠定了基礎。
